inputs.name: PlaywrightReportAdapter.ingest.store
inputs.description: Repository instance used to write a check for each qualifying spec and evidence for each eligible image attachment. Its record implementation supplies the persistence behavior.

inputs.name: PlaywrightReportAdapter.ingest.id
inputs.description: Identifier forwarded as the first argument to store.record for every generated check and evidence record. The adapter does not validate or transform it.

inputs.name: PlaywrightReportAdapter.ingest.file
inputs.description: Path read as UTF-8 and parsed as the Playwright report; its directory is used to resolve relative attachment paths. Missing top-level suites default to an empty list, while nested report shapes are not validated.

outputs.name: PlaywrightReportAdapter.ingest
outputs.description: Resolves to an object containing the number of specs with a nonempty tests array that the adapter records. It counts qualifying specs, not individual tests or evidence attachments.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when the readable report contents are not valid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when malformed suite, spec, or attachment values have incompatible shapes for traversal or path handling; the adapter does not validate the report schema.

errors.name: Playwright report file read failure
errors.description: A file read failure from readFile rejects ingestion with the filesystem error.

errors.name: ReportRepository.record rejection
errors.description: A rejection from an awaited store.record call propagates unchanged; this adapter does not determine the rejection value or its name.
